$description: SEMANTIC colour roles, light theme. Every value aliases a primitive; a literal here would be a primitive hiding in the wrong layer. Step choices follow the usable-range rule in COLOR.md: body text sits at step 600 or darker on a light surface. Provisional until HAUX-33 validates the full contrast matrix.

text.$description: The primary role used as text on a page or surface, not as a fill. A fill is chosen to carry a legible label on top of it, which is a different requirement and a different number.

surface.$description: A quiet tint for a chip or a callout. Opaque, never an alpha: an alpha tint measures differently on a page than inside a card, so it has no single contrast figure to assert against.
